name: Lord Baurles K. Wishock
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Lord Baurles K. Wishock lives among the petitioners and dignitaries. Barkeeps know him for unpaid tabs and a taste for strong drink, but his nights in the city’s underbelly brought him near darker dealings.

sections.title: A Nobleman's Dangerous Curiosity
sections.body: Lord Baurles K. Wishock moves among petitioners and dignitaries in Stormwind Keep, where he belongs to the influential House of Nobles. Though his station is high, he often drinks in the Mage Quarter’s dive bars, especially the Slaughtered Lamb, and leaves large bills unpaid. There, he hears of a warlock coven practicing dark arts in cellars beneath the floorboards. Wishock sets out to have the tavern closed and asks fellow nobles for a formal investigation. Uncovering demonic cabals in Stormwind rarely goes unpunished.

sections.title: A Poisoned Cup
sections.body: Lord Baurles K. Wishock’s efforts put him in the warlocks’ sights. To avoid royal scrutiny and an inquiry into their underground sanctum, Zardeth of the Black Claw arranges the nobleman’s quiet killing. The coven exploits Wishock’s thirst for luxury vintages, preparing a lethal drink disguised as fine ale. A hired adventurer is arranged to carry it to Wishock beneath the Keep guards’ noses.

faq.q: Who is Lord Baurles K. Wishock?
faq.answer: Lord Baurles K. Wishock belongs to the House of Nobles and spends his days in the Petitioner's Chamber inside Stormwind Keep. In the Mage Quarter, barkeeps know him for large, unpaid drinking tabs.

faq.q: Where can Lord Wishock be found?
faq.answer: Lord Baurles K. Wishock can be found in the Petitioner's Chamber on the eastern side of Stormwind Keep, among courtiers, diplomats, and supplicants awaiting royal attention.

faq.q: Why do the warlocks beneath the Slaughtered Lamb want him dead?
faq.answer: At the Slaughtered Lamb, Lord Baurles K. Wishock learns that a warlock coven operates beneath the tavern. He seeks a formal inquiry from the House of Nobles and wants the establishment closed, threatening to expose their operations.

Zardeth of the Black Claw prepares a deadly poison disguised as an exquisite drink. An agent brings the poisoned cask to Lord Baurles K. Wishock in Stormwind Keep, where his taste for fine alcohol and free drinks makes him an easy target.

angles.text: As a warlock, you know Wishock’s investigation of the Slaughtered Lamb threatens Stormwind’s shadow coven. His quiet death becomes a priority for its members.
As a human, you see the House of Nobles’ decadent, self-serving reputation reflected in the Petitioner's Chamber during the boy-king Anduin’s early reign.
